evidence.reason: `process_state` treats any readable `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` as proof of liveness. On Linux a zombie still has a readable but empty cmdline, so an unreaped killed fixture child can be reported as `alive=True` and retain its original `starttime`, producing a false survival/drain result. The routine fix is to read the process state from `/proc/<pid>/stat` and reject zombie/dead states before setting `alive=True`; this does not require an owner decision.
